Practically insoluble in wa- ter; freely soluble in dehydrated alcohol and in acetone; dissolves in dilute solutions of alkali carbonates and alkali hydroxides. Store in airtight containers. A white or al- most white, hygroscopic powder. Freely soluble in water; practi- cally insoluble in dehydrated alcohol and in chloroform. A 0.5% solution in water has a pH of 7.5 to 9.0.
